price_basis: Retail electricity including supply, transmission, distribution, taxes and fees. Household: average annual household use; business: 1000000 kWh/year.
notes: USD values as displayed by source; exchange-rate date unspecified. Electricity only, not total energy spending. Ranking uses total national energy consumption, not per-capita or electricity consumption.
electricity_mix_basis: Share of electricity generated domestically, not capacity or electricity consumed.
primary_energy_mix_basis: Share of primary energy consumed using the substitution method; includes transport and heating. Not domestic energy extraction/production. Traditional biomass is excluded.
mix_notes: Shares expressed as percentages (0-100), rounded to 2 decimals. Other is 100 minus the six displayed shares and includes nuclear and other renewables. Electricity oil_and_other_fossil uses OWID oil_share_elec, mapped from Ember Other fossil; not a pure-oil estimate. The primary-energy oil share is separate oil consumption. Mix source: Our World in Data, Ember electricity data (2026), Energy Institute Statistical Review (2025).
production_trade_notes: Gross imports and exports are cross-border flows. Negative net imports mean net exports. Domestic production includes output that may be exported. Total energy: IEA 2023 energy balances, TJ divided by 1000000 to get EJ; exports converted from signed balance entries to positive volumes. Electricity: EIA 2024, billion kWh equals TWh. EIA generation totals may differ from the OWID/Ember generation used for the existing source-share columns. IEA balances use different primary-energy accounting from the existing OWID substitution-method shares; do not multiply those shares by these production totals. Electricity imports and exports are preliminary in the EIA source.
